author: Inside Edition
description: The Twin Towers of the World Trade Center, recreated in drone lights, rose again. The drones, 2,977 of them, represent each lost life. The drones flew in a stunning commemoration 25 years after 9/11. On the morning of September 11th, 2001, Inside Edition's Matt Meagher was one of the first reporters on the scene in New York, capturing devastating video of the towers falling. Here's a look back at how Inside Edition covered the deadliest domestic terror attack in U.S. history, as it unfolded.
title: How Inside Edition Covered The 9/11 Terror Attacks As They Happened

author: Inside Edition
description: September 11, 2026 marks 25 years since the terror attacks that changed America forever. Those lost on that fateful day are gone, but they are certainly not forgotten. Inside Edition looks at how the nation is paying tribute on this emotional milestone.
title: How Inside Edition Is Remembering Those Lost On 9/11

author: Inside Edition
description: Judge Judy is passing the gavel to none other than her son, Adam Levy, as he debuts his own court show. After 30 years of no-nonsense rulings, Judge Judy says she is ready to hang up her robe. Levy, a former district attorney in Upstate New York, says viewers can expect the same sharp wit his mom is famous for. And, the show "Flip Side" is back for its third season.
title: Judge Judy Passes Down Gavel To Her Son For 'Adam's Law' Debut

author: Inside Edition
description: Aaron and Clare Walenga were on a romantic stroll in Florida, walking hand-in-hand. But their walk ended in disaster when the couple, who have been married for 17 years, were struck by lightning. Police bodycam captured the immediate aftermath of the strike, as good Samaritans rushed to their aid. Now, the Walengas are talking with Inside Edition's Alison Hall about fighting for their lives, together.
title: Bodycam Video Shows Married Couple After Being Struck By Lightning

author: Inside Edition
description: A knife-wielding man jumped on the top of a pickup truck, chasing a man running for his life. According to reports, the knife-wielding man flew into a jealous rage after spotting his ex-girlfriend in the park with the other man. The woman tried to intervene. A witness was behind the wheel of his Tesla and his vehicle recorded everything. Ann Mercogliano has the details.
title: Terrifying Knife Attack Caught On Camera

author: Inside Edition
description:
Sponsored Content by RoC Skincare.

Inside Edition teamed up with RoC® Skincare and its paid partner, dermatologist Dr. Sheila Farhang, for tips on treating wrinkles around the eyes. Dr. Farhang says one solution is a cosmetic surgery known as blepharoplasty, but that can be expensive and requires at least two weeks of downtime. She recommends RoC's Retinol Correxion Line Smoothing Eye Cream as a cost-effective solution to help firm the look of the eye area.
title: Dermatologist's Tip For Treating Lines Around The Eyes

author: Inside Edition
description: A child that got stuck in a pond was saved with the help of a drone. The Saint Paul Police Department in Minnesota released this video of the rescue. Once the camera located the child, who was struggling to stay afloat, an officer waded into the pond to get him. In one movement the officer scooped up the child and walked him to dry land. Another officer was waiting there to help carry the child to be evaluated. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Police Drone Helps Find Autistic Child Lost In Pond

author: Inside Edition
description: Deputies came to a standoff with a goat, so they tried to take control of the situation. Deputies from the Snohomish County Sheriff's Office in Washington found out the hard way that this runaway goat didn't want to go home. They say it had tried to ram people who came into contact with it, so it was a risk to try and wrangle it. While the deputies were able to get a good grip on its horns, coaxing it back to its pen wouldn't be so easy. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Deputies Struggle To Get Runaway Goat Back To Its Pen

author: Inside Edition
description: A former artificial intelligence researcher is sounding the alarm on the threat AI poses to humanity. Jacob Coxon, who has worked for both OpenAI and Anthropic – two of the leading companies developing artificial intelligence systems – appeared on CNN last night. He told Anderson Cooper that AI systems' ability to grow exponentially smarter without human involvement poses a threat to life on Earth, noting, "they could cause extreme havoc."
title: AI Researcher Quits, Warning Technology Poses Existential Threat To Human Life
